question: Ramadan or Ramazan is the ______ month of Islamic calendar and is observed by Muslims worldwide as a month of fasting.
solution:
The correct answer is __**9th.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramadan or Ramazan** is the **ninth** month of Islamic calendar and is observed by Muslims worldwide as a** month of fasting.**
 
• Ramadan is considered as the **holiest month** in the Islamic calendar.
 
• During Ramadan, Muslims fast from dawn until sunset, **abstaining** from food, drink, and other physical needs.
 
• It is believed that fasting during Ramadan is a way to **purify the soul **and gain a deeper understanding of **Allah's blessings.**
 
• The end of Ramadan is marked by **Eid al-Fitr, **a major festival in the Islamic calendar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Muslim calendar **and Islamic calendar are other terms used to refer to the** Hijri calendar** in English.
 
• It is a lunar calendar with **12 lunar months** and** 354 or 355 days** in a year.
 
• It is employed to ascertain the appropriate dates for Islamic holidays and customs, including the** annual fasting period** and the time of the big **pilgrimage. **
